scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind typing words and sentences.
Home row: is the resting row for touch typing. Top row: contains letters Q through P.
Bottom row: contains letters Z through M. Practice: helps develop accuracy before speed. Posture: keeps shoulders relaxed while typing.
With an adult supervising, practise home row and top row using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
